Row.Text: A strange disease on this land has begun infecting our newly settled city with mysterious symptoms that appears to be impossible to treat. Advisors suggest we continue living here, so that the inhabitants can build up a "defense" against it as seen with the many observed animals here.
Keep our inhabitants well-rested. Even if we can't treat this, it may contain medical properties.
Hard decisions always look easier after you make them. Our descendants will thank us for having the courage to do this.
